description: Land Acquisition - Kurukude, Hali Ela D/S Division, Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a declaration by the Minister of Lands that specific parcels of land are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. The content includes detailed descriptions of the land lots, their boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions a government minister, the core focus is on land matters rather than government personnel or structural changes, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
